sql:
WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT seniority, comp_mid_usd
    FROM fct_posting
    WHERE is_open = TRUE 
      AND remote_us = TRUE 
      AND is_canonical_listing = TRUE
      AND comp_mid_usd IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    seniority, 
    median(comp_mid_usd) AS median_pay, 
    median(comp_mid_usd) - (SELECT median(comp_mid_usd) FROM filtered) AS diff_from_overall
FROM filtered
GROUP BY seniority
